checks.name: console_entry_and_dependency_group
checks.evidence: pyproject.toml declares cst-bench -> cst_mil.bench.cli:main and benchmark dependency group; --frozen preserves locked resolution.

checks.name: six_methods_match_cli
checks.evidence: runner.py:33 METHODS lists exactly lda, btm, gsdmm, nmf, bertopic, cst_mil; cli.py:26-33 accepts full677, --limit, --resume.

checks.name: selection_resolution
checks.evidence: runner.py:244-246 resolves cst_mil without explicit revision from frozen selection.json; current selected revision is r0.

checks.name: reject_limit_3000
checks.evidence: runner.py:297-299 restricts integer limit to [0,len(sessions)] or all; full677 maximum is 677.

checks.name: limit_is_cumulative_inference
checks.evidence: runner.py:450-452 visits sessions[:target] and skips previously completed IDs; target is not used to select fitting rows.

checks.name: full_training_before_limited_inference
checks.evidence: runner constructs fitting rows from train/dev before the inference loop; model.py:356-357 splits these into fit=train and threshold-selection=dev. Therefore --limit 300 still uses all 406 training and 135 validation conversations.

checks.name: trained_model_reused
checks.evidence: runner.py:366-373 validates model SHA256, loads model.joblib and optionally validates external assets; training is only in the else branch.

checks.name: partial_training_preserved
checks.evidence: runner.py:374 and 392 increment formal_fit_attempts and use distinct assets/attempt_N directories when no complete TRAINED.json exists.

checks.name: per_session_resume_integrity
checks.evidence: runner.py:441-443 verifies binding/model/prediction hashes, checks unique valid session IDs, then skips already completed sessions.

checks.name: all_complete_resume_no_retrain
checks.evidence: Existing model is loaded; every completed session is skipped. Summary evaluation/status can run again, as documented.

checks.name: error_and_new_version_guidance
checks.evidence: Guide does not invent --new-run. Current CLI has no generic namespace option; revision values are the preregistered CST r0-r3. Frozen run mismatch is rejected instead of mixing results. Ordinary interruption resumes with unchanged binding.

checks.name: status_and_compare_commands
checks.evidence: cli.py status accepts full677 and reports per-method status; compare accepts full677 and calls reporting only, not training.

checks.name: full_training_not_started_in_canonical_namespace
checks.scope: Canonical experiment artifacts at audit time; no full677 run directory, manifest, or trained model exists there.

checks.name: cpu_documentation_matches_enforcement
checks.evidence: cli.py configures CPU affinity before numerical imports; runner also configures affinity and rejects observed training/inference affinity width beyond the configured cap.

checks.name: model_and_cache_locations
checks.evidence: Guide correctly distinguishes cst_mil/benchmark/tools from repository-root benchmark/models and benchmark/cache for BERTopic.

limitations: This is command/schema and implementation-flow review, not a full677 execution test. The six-method smoke validation is documented separately.
Guide intentionally does not claim final pilot results before the corresponding report/verification artifacts are generated.
